race.comment: Tough race. SUN SISTER (10) relished the drop in grade with a dominant win as fav over 1050m at the Gold Coast Poly. Claim helps again and has the speed to get over from the draw. Go close. THUNDEROUS (2) sat off the good speed and was strong through the line on the quick backup when second over 1200m at Warwick. Senior rider hops aboard and expected to go close. A TOUCH FROM FAYT (3) relished the heavy track four back when saluting at Ballina. Hasn't been that far away of late and capable of taking a hand in the finish. TORONESS (5) handy mare returning with a stack of gear changes. Trialled well and not to be underestimated.
